title: Lia visitou a tia
goal: Pergunte com Did + sujeito + verbo base e responda com Yes, I did ou No, I did not.
reading: Lia visited her aunt on Sunday.
A Lia visitou a tia no domingo.
O Ben ligou para a Lia naquela noite.
He wanted to know about the visit.
Lia told him about the horses and the roads.
A Lia contou a ele sobre os cavalos e as estradas.
dialogue: Yes, I did. It was fun.
Yes, she did. She made soup.
Did you call Ben after dinner?
Você ligou para o Ben depois do jantar?
No, I did not. I was tired.
Yes, I did. It was very big.
pron: Na fala rápida did you soa “dídjiu”: o d e o y se juntam.
gram: Pergunta sobre o passado começa com Did.

summers: A tia dela anda a cavalo nos verões.
